## Verified Projects

   - Stack: Python, YOLOv8 segmentation, MobileSAM boundary refinement, ArUco marker homography, FastAPI, React Native (Expo), ONNX/TFLite.
   - Outcome: First Prize, RTGS Hackathon.
2. Highway Road Accident Prevention System:
   - Status: In development. Hazard, pedestrian, and vehicular detection models.
3. Real-Time Weapon & Threat Detection System:
   - Edge vision pipeline detecting weapons in CCTV streams with YOLOv8.
4. Hybrid GraphRAG Knowledge System:
   - Hybrid retrieval architecture combining Neo4j knowledge graph traversal and ChromaDB vector search with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings.
